tasks.short: Set and maintain game banks and table limits

steps.what: Review actual game activity, bank position and applicable risk constraints
Assemble selected game exposure and bank totals for the limit review
Choose the actual bank and table limits for each game within the applicable risk framework
Prepare the actual game-limit configuration and document its rationale
Check the complete configuration against the selected game, limit and bank values
Save the working configuration package in the same system
Perform the actual existing separate risk-authority release review of the completed limit change
Activate the exact released bank and table-limit configuration for the actual games

tasks.design: Configure an exposure summary from selected game records in {OTHER}, the gaming and bank-control system. Keep actual limit decisions, configuration, checking and operative activation with the existing people and release route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Game and bank totals could be manually assembled before limit review.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed game identifiers and exposure fields can support a native grouped view.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate limits depend on game risk, liquidity and actual operating constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The manager balances actual risk and service needs within delegated authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed game and bank fields can support exposure summaries while limit choices remain human decisions.

assumptions: This episode applies only where a separate casino risk authority already releases this class of game-limit change. Do not invent an approval role or its baseline time; verify the actual route before using this graph.

Gaming transaction records originate in actual game operations; s1 counts manager checks and mapping of game identifier, period, bank amount and exposure measure. Missing fields stay manual; no new free staff reporting feed is assumed.
The final configuration and rationale exist before s7. Any game, value, effective period or configuration change voids a1. s8 is actual operative activation, distinct from the ordinary working save.
Test native exposure views first. Existing automatic summaries earn zero new saving. Save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated; manager checking is not self-approval.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates; actual transaction-capture labour is not claimed as manager saving.
research_questions: Which totals are actually assembled manually, and who already releases operative limit changes?

Actual existing separate risk-authority review remains counted outside the focal denominator.

tasks.short: Direct compilation of wager and payoff summaries

steps.what: Capture actual wager, event and payoff transactions in the gaming records
Specify the actual summary period, event groups and fields and check source completeness
Compile the selected wager and payoff fields into event summary sheets
Check summary totals, event mapping, reversals and missing transactions against actual records
Direct the actual compilation workers on unresolved summary exceptions
Write the actual working summary-exception record and its source references
Save the working summary record in the same store

tasks.design: Configure summary sheets directly from checked transaction fields in {OTHER}, the gaming transaction system, rather than recopying them into {SPREADSHEET}. Keep the manager's compilation direction, completeness checks and actual working exception record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Summary compilation could duplicate transaction entry across systems.
tasks.enabler_now: Event identifiers and fixed transaction amounts support deterministic grouping and totals.
tasks.still_hard: Voids, corrections and missing event links need real investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager determines whether the summary faithfully represents actual activity.

ambition.what: Review a separate event-level exception view before completing the period summary.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: recorded transaction identifiers and amounts can produce fixed summary sheets without interpreting unresolved exceptions.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual transaction capture, manager-directed compilation and the working summary, not an invented external report. Staff capture is explicit other-role labour and fully retained.
Staff produce transaction identifier, event identifier, timestamp, wager, payoff, status and reversal link in s1; the manager checks and maps scope in s2. Missing data are not silently inferred.
Test native gaming reports first. Already automatic summaries earn zero new saving; the estimate applies only to actual manager compilation effort, not an imagined spreadsheet baseline.
Any actual external submission or final operative financial commitment requires its real authority and separate final-version action. Same-system save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates. Transaction capture shared with task7200 or another role must be counted once, not added again.

tasks.short: Review operating and betting accounts for accuracy

steps.what: Produce the actual expense, budget, betting-account and collection source records
Read actual review sources and identify the relevant periods, account keys and comparison rules
Match selected account amounts and recompute fixed totals and variances
Investigate actual exceptions and assess source support, timing and account meaning
Write the actual working review findings and unresolved discrepancies
Save the working review record in the same store

tasks.design: Compare exact account keys and fixed totals from {ERP} and {OTHER}, the betting-account system, using deterministic rules. The manager still checks source meaning, investigates discrepancies and writes the actual working review record in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching amounts and recomputing totals could be repeated manually during accuracy review.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit account, period and reversal keys support fixed comparisons without explaining discrepancies automatically.
tasks.still_hard: A numerical mismatch may reflect timing, a valid adjustment or a real error.
tasks.human_edge: The manager judges whether the records represent actual operations accurately.

ambition.what: Inspect a separate reversal-and-cutoff exception view before completing the review.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit keys and arithmetic support deterministic account comparisons while discrepancy interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual accuracy review with its working findings, not correction posting, payment release or external reporting. Actual corrective commits and sends need their own real final-version authority and action.

Accounting staff produce the actual source records in s1, fully counted. Manager mapping in s2 covers account, period, transaction identifier, amount, currency and reversal link; missing keys remain manual.

tasks.short: Settle actual bets and issue receipts

steps.what: Present the actual betting ticket and payout claim
Read and validate the actual ticket, event result and settlement terms
Calculate the exact settlement amount and prepare the transaction and receipt fields
Check the final ticket settlement, customer entitlement, amount and receipt details and authorize the actual payout
Pay the exact authorized cash settlement to the actual claimant
Issue the exact authorized settlement receipt to the customer
Record the actual completed payout and receipt identifier in the working transaction record
Save the ordinary completed-transaction record in the same system

tasks.design: Use the native settlement calculation and receipt-field preparation in {OTHER}, the betting settlement and cashier system, where those fields are still assembled manually. The manager retains actual claimant checks, financial payout authorization, cash handling, receipt issue and completed-transaction recording.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual settlement arithmetic and field preparation could be separate from cash handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated ticket fields and fixed settlement terms can calculate a proposed packet without choosing claimant entitlement.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed tickets, voids and entitlement cannot be settled from arithmetic alone.
tasks.human_edge: The manager verifies the actual claim and exercises real financial transaction authority.

ambition.what: No expanded gambling, credit or payout authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed ticket settlement terms can calculate a proposed payout while actual entitlement checks and cash handling remain human.

assumptions: This is the statement's actual payoff branch, including its real receipt and transaction record. Bet acceptance or collection is a different real transaction, not an unpriced alternative hidden in this graph.

The customer produces the ticket claim in s1; the manager validates ticket identifier, event result, stake, odds or settlement terms, currency and status in s2. Missing or disputed fields stay manual.

s4 is the actual financial authorization of a machine-prepared settlement packet, not author approval of a note or save. The manager must already hold the actual payout authority; otherwise count and use the actual authority. Any claimant, amount or receipt-detail change voids a1/a2.
Actual payout and receipt issue remain separate fully retained actions. Post-transaction recording follows the actual events; ordinary same-system save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated.

Test native settlement configuration first. If calculation and receipt fields are already native, their existing runtime earns zero new saving. Estimates apply to actual manual settlement preparation only, not an invented common baseline.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates; customer time is outside the focal denominator and any transaction capture reused by summaries is counted once.
